# Thomas Hsiao

[Postdoctoral Researcher in Biostatistics]{.position}

::: {.bio}
I develop statistical methods to learn about health from complex, imperfect data. My research brings together **causal inference**, **spatiotemporal statistics**, and **informative missingness**, with applications in environmental health, electronic health records, and disease surveillance.

I am a postdoctoral researcher at Emory University, working with Howard H. Chang and Razieh Nabi. I received my PhD in Biostatistics from Emory in 2025, advised by Lance Waller.
:::
